t: 提尔城在被围困了19周后倒向了威尼斯十字军.
te: The city of Tyre falls to the Venetian Crusade after a siege of 19 weeks.

t: 教宗霍诺利乌斯二世被尊崇,在教宗-选帝侯塞拉斯蒂涅二世受到争议后当选.
te: Pope Honorius II is consecrated, having been elected after the controversial dethroning of Pope-Elect Celestine II.
